summary: Validated mobile onboarding for all age groups, home navigation, gameplay answering, settings access, public API, admin auth, and protected CRUD. Core gameplay and backend pass; frontend admin integration is unavailable.

integration_issues.issue: Admin screen always shows 'Admin service is unavailable' because src/api/admin.ts reads Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl, while app configuration exposes no extra.backendUrl and the configured backend variable is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.

action_items: Update admin API URL resolution to use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (or the existing supported Expo env mechanism), then retest invalid/valid login and all admin tabs.
Add testID attributes to admin inputs/buttons and settings controls to improve reliable mobile regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin API URL configuration is disconnected from the actual frontend environment, causing a deterministic client-side failure despite healthy backend endpoints.
Game UI labels the local benchmark as 'AI benchmark', which conflicts with the offline/no-external-AI scope and should be renamed.

success_rate.frontend: 80% of exercised flows passed; admin integration failed

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a TEST_ question; created a TEST_ challenge for API verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use fresh localStorage for onboarding. Public API root, invalid/valid backend login, protected question CRUD, and challenge creation passed. Admin UI currently cannot reach API because API_ROOT is empty.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: choose any age, open admin, submit any credentials; UI displays Admin service is unavailable without a network request. In src/api/admin.ts, backendUrl = Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.backendUrl. app.json has no expo.extra.backendUrl, while frontend/.env defines EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Therefore API_ROOT becomes an empty string and request() throws before fetch.
